purpose: Teach: 滑走/注入/征服/履修/標高/図形/代謝/点滴

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、空港の滑走路侵入事案を、警察、扱われてますね
lines.en: So the police are handling this airport runway intrusion case, aren't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful. Soft start, drawing Ren's question out as though he's checking his understanding. Measured pace. The tone of someone genuinely trying to understand a serious matter.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、薬物注入事件を厳しく捜査します
lines.en: The police are investigating the drug injection case with full attention.
lines.style: Direct, official tone. Clear attack on each phrase. Professional cadence, steady and measured. No emotion — just factual briefing. Shoulders level, posture composed.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、ハッカーの征服宣言を、警察、注視されてますね
lines.en: And the police are monitoring that hacker's declaration of intent, correct?
lines.style: Careful, respectful inquiry. Slightly rising at the end — checking rather than stating. Slower pace. The politeness of someone asking an authority figure to confirm they've understood.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、警察学校での履修課目を整備します
lines.en: The police are establishing a revised curriculum at the police academy.
lines.style: Steady, administrative tone. Even delivery. Professional but not cold — the voice of someone describing necessary procedure. No inflection, just clear information.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、標高の高い山岳事件を、警察、扱われてますね
lines.en: So the police are also handling that high-altitude mountain incident, aren't they?
lines.style: Continued line of inquiry. Quiet, deliberate. Slight pause before the final phrase. The tone of someone building a picture, asking each piece without rushing.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯行現場を図形で記録します
lines.en: The police document crime scenes using diagrammatic records.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact delivery. Slight technical precision to the language — specific, methodical. Calm and authoritative without being stern. A statement of procedure, not debate.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、薬物代謝の鑑定を、警察、依頼されますね
lines.en: And the police are requested to conduct forensic analysis of the drug's metabolism?
lines.style: Deferential but engaged. Slight hesitation before 'forensic' — checking the term. Quiet respect in the voice. The tone of someone asking permission to understand.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、点滴に薬物が混入された事案も把握しております
lines.en: The police are aware of cases where drugs have been mixed into IV drips as well.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Warm but official — acknowledging complexity. Slow pace on the final clause. The reassurance of experience: we see these things, we're aware. Steady eye contact implied.
